notes.title: What is currently happening with Scrap Bastion
notes.content:
[h1]Current changes in the works[/h1]
We have been working on the map, which when the game loads, looks like the game is crashing.  We have decided that instead of having a complete random map that has no limits, to limit the mapsize.  The reasons for it is we want to add multiplayer to the game, vs and co-op mode, and thus would need a more limited map, for a more arena style play.

[h2]Upcoming Changes[/h2]
After taking what we want to do with Scrap Bastion into what we currently have, we have decided to share the news of what the game will be on release

- More maptypes with Unique plays to it, not just an open field
- The game will change from 2D top down, to 2.5D, giving more depth, but still give the 2D topdown 
  effect. 
- Adding Multiplayer co-op and vs mode
- Adding random map generation, where maps will be generated for the game, with seeds
- Changing the current play to the boss spawning every x amount of time, to the boss grows, and 
  enemies spawn from certain points within the boss base
- Story and Biography updates(giving you more insight as to what scrap bastion is about)
- Leaderboard
- Unlock system

[h3]More Upcoming changes(Awaiting funding)[/h3]
- Graphic changes to bring the 2D world to a 3D world. Better animations and enhancement on graphics for the player, enemies and world itself
- More game modes
- In depth Sounds effects
- Advanced features
- Better enemy AI

Keep an eye out, we will be keeping you up to date with all that is happening, and updating the game as we go :-)
